issues.reason: All four heritage vectors replace baseline DEX/WIS/INT vector AND Keen Senses skill; heritage vs alternate replacement resolution must be tested to avoid stacking.
Questioning Knowledge specialization and Weapon Familiarity weapon catalog are open-ended choices. Both selectors are intentionally unresolved; no auto-grants.
Desert Delver Endurance prerequisite-only and 20-degree adjustment; Bite primary/secondary and Blinded conditional scent require combat/sense runtime review.
11 race-specific favored rewards require canonical class feature ID/revision and fractional cap reconciliation; remain manual.
Staging-only source paraphrases and effects are not independent rules approval; source text is not bundled or licensed. Live wizard and sheet behavior has not been tested.

Source race page names high-INT options but does not spell out count/reselection mechanics; formula max(0, INT_MOD) is a provisional standard-system interpretation only, not approved for auto-application.

Standard testing supports printed DEX/WIS/INT vector, humanoid/reptilian identity, Perception/Acrobatics, low-light vision, six optional languages and owned +1 natural armor. Grounded bull-rush/trip CMD, environmental checks/resistance, Endurance qualification, bite primary/secondary handling and Deft Pugilist remain manual. No general Endurance or Improved Unarmed Strike feat is inferred; variants, alternates and independent full review pending.

features.name: Ability Score Adjustment
features.description: +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, −2 Intelligence.

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium; no size bonus or penalty.

features.name: Type
features.description: Humanoid with the reptilian subtype.

features.name: Base Speed
features.description: Land speed 30 feet.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Starts speaking Common and Banganese. High-Intelligence bonus language choices: Draconic, Giant, Ignan, Numish, Seeq, Terran.

features.name: Desert Delver
features.description: +4 racial to Constitution checks and Fortitude saves to avoid fatigue, exhaustion, and adverse effects from running, forced marches, starvation, thirst, hot/cold environments. Treat temperature as 20 degrees cooler or warmer for extreme heat or cold. Counts as Endurance for feat prerequisites, but otherwise stacks with Endurance feat.

condition.description: Fatigue, exhaustion or ill effects from running, forced marches, starvation, thirst, and hot/cold environments

effects.textValue: Treat temperature as 20°F warmer or cooler for extreme heat/cold effects; Endurance counts only toward feat prerequisites, other Endurance benefit stacks.

features.name: Elemental Resistance
features.description: Resist 5 fire and resist 5 ice (not every element).

features.name: Stability
features.description: +4 racial CMD only to resist bull rush or trip while standing on ground.

condition.description: Only while standing on ground, versus bull rush and trip

features.name: Thick-skinned
features.description: +1 natural armor bonus.

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: +2 racial Perception.

features.name: Well-Balanced
features.description: +2 racial Acrobatics.

features.name: Bite
features.description: Natural bite dealing 1d3 damage. Primary when not using manufactured weapons, secondary when wielding manufactured weapons.

effects.textValue: 1d3 bite; primary except secondary if wielding manufactured weapons.

features.name: Deft Pugilist
features.description: Always considered armed when making unarmed attacks; these do not provoke an attack of opportunity.

effects.textValue: Unarmed strikes count as armed and do not provoke attack of opportunity.

features.name: Low-Light Vision
features.description: Can see twice as far as a hume in dim light.

effects.textValue: Twice normal hume distance in dim light

features.name: Blinded
features.description: Blind, but gain scent. While able to use scent, no usual blindness penalties; if scent is unusable, the blindness limitation remains. Replaces Low-Light Vision.

effects.textValue: Apply blinded status and scent together; scent substitutes for blindness penalties only while usable. Blindness/scent interactions must be adjudicated.

features.name: Claws
features.description: Gain TWO secondary natural claws, each 1d3 damage, instead of natural armor Thick-skinned.

effects.textValue: Two separate secondary claw attacks; 1d3 damage each.

features.name: Prehensile Tail
features.description: Tail can carry objects but cannot wield a weapon. Retrieve a small stowed item carried on the body as a swift action. Replaces Stability.

effects.textValue: Retrieve small personal stowed item as swift action; cannot attack or wield weapon with tail.

features.name: Questioning
features.description: All existing Knowledge skills become class skills; select ONE Knowledge specialty for a +2 racial bonus. Replaces Well-Balanced.

effects.textValue: All existing Knowledge specializations count as class skills; create no new rows.

features.name: Weapon Familiarity
features.description: Gain proficiency with ONE chosen weapon, selected from the weapon catalog. Replaces Deft Pugilist.
